description: Ambiguous is the workspace for human-AI collaboration. 17 productivity apps rebuilt from scratch to make work flow across Docs, Mail, Chat, Sheets, CRM, Calendar, and more. Each AI coworker has its own identity and works in the same apps and on the same data like the rest of the team. You can send it an email, message it in chat, assign it a task, or @mention it in a comment. Teams of up to five can use all 17 apps for free, and agents can get started through CLI or MCP in under a minute.

defaultPrompt: Plan my day from my calendar, unread emails, and upcoming tasks.
Create a project update for the week from recent chats, documents, and completed tasks.
Start a wiki page for the onboarding guide
